text:
```yaml
name: Build and Push Custom Docker Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .ci/container/Dockerfile
      - .ci/container/**
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
        with:
          platforms: linux/amd64

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .ci/container
          file: .ci/container/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/codenameone/codenameone:pr-ci-${{ github.sha }}
            ghcr.io/codenameone/codenameone:pr-ci-latest
          cache-from: type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/codenameone/codenameone:pr-ci-latest
          cache-to: type=inline
```
